items.headline: Broadcom shares rise after $63 billion financing deal to expand Anthropic AI capacity
items.summary: Broadcom gained 4.2% after announcing a financing arrangement under which Wall Street firms would help Anthropic obtain Broadcom AI accelerators and networking solutions.

items.headline: Nvidia helps lift the S&P 500 as AI stocks rebound
items.summary: Nvidia rose 0.8% and was identified as one of the strongest contributors to the market's advance alongside other AI-linked stocks.

items.headline: General Motors announces move from NYSE to Nasdaq
items.summary: GM rose 5.6% after announcing its Nasdaq listing move, which could make it eligible for Nasdaq-100 inclusion and attract buying from index-tracking funds.

items.headline: CoreWeave rallies as AI infrastructure shares recover
items.summary: CoreWeave gained 8.5% as AI-related shares posted a second winning day following recent volatility tied to financing and data-center spending concerns.

items.headline: Micron gains after SK Hynix reports strong AI-memory demand
items.summary: Micron rose 4.3% after SK Hynix reported strong profitability and said AI demand should continue exceeding memory supply through 2030.
